newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Int'l Rectifier rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Int'l Rectifier rated a buy.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co Thursday initiated coverage of International Rectifier Corp as a buy with an outperform rating and a price target of $25 a share.

-- Analyst Mona Eraiba cited the company's leading position in the semiconductor components market. She also said the company's orders and earnings appear to have bottomed out after what she described as a "severe" industry correction.
-- Eraiba said International Rectifier is a major innovator in the semiconductor power sector with a strong patent portfolio.
-- Its stock was down one Thursday afternoon at 15-1/2.
